Design a system to measure the grazing behaviour of cows, camels and goats in the Dhofar mountains of Oman, to protect rangeland and native vegetation and propose a better grazing system for farmers and their animals. Search the internet for similar peer-reviewed studies and relevant Dhofar/Oman evidence. Compare GPS and motion sensors, direct observation and vegetation monitoring; explain what each measures and how to validate animal behaviour. Produce an initial research-backed plan covering pilot design, seasonal sampling including khareef, animal welfare and farmer participation, system architecture, analysis, indicative cost assumptions, evaluation metrics and a phased implementation roadmap. Cite source links, separate evidence from proposed choices, and identify missing local data.
